product_one_liner.value: Appspace is a workplace-experience platform for organizations that brings employee communications, intranet, digital signage, space and room management, and visitor management together for communications, HR, facilities, and IT teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes the platform as connecting people, places, and spaces and lists the related workplace products and teams.

pricing_page.notes: The public page compares Free, Express, and Enterprise plans, although it does not list standard subscription prices.

named_customers.notes: All names appear in Appspace customer case studies.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile classifies Appspace as 201–500 employees; the page reports 481 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Tampa, Florida as the headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Appspace's company history and careers page date its founding to 2002.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows workplace, product, release, and company content, but not two engineering-authored posts about product architecture, infrastructure, data, or implementation.

public_docs.notes: The public Appspace Community knowledge base includes multiple product how-to and administration articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live openings listed include sales, engineering, and product roles, but no AI, ML, machine-learning, data-science, scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision title.

model_provider.value: Appspace says Intelligence uses its own default AI model (the model is not named) and supports provider options including Microsoft Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry/Azure AI Foundry, and Google Gemini/Gemini Enterprise.
model_provider.notes: The company publicly names the supported providers but does not disclose the identity of its default model.

compliance_certs.notes: A-LIGN says Appspace achieved SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001:2022. Appspace's trust page also lists its ISO 27001 certificate. SOC 3 and ISO 27017 are omitted because they are outside the requested certification list.

last_funding.notes: The latest round is described as a strategic growth investment/growth equity and is dated September 21, 2023. The announcement does not disclose the amount; 0 is a placeholder for undisclosed, not a claim that the investment was zero.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest funding round found was dated September 2023, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current listings include Business Development Representative and Account Executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: Appspace announced Appspace Context on September 29, 2026, and a Vela product release on October 9, 2026; both fall within the six months before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On March 19, 2026, Appspace announced Eric Daggett as Chief Sales Officer and Dan Ward as Chief Technology Officer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Appspace's Business Development Representative job listing names these sales tools/platforms, including Salesforce and Gong.io.
